fact: The October-November 2025 issue (no. 36) of the Mauritania pastoral monitoring bulletin, an early-warning product validated by the National Pastoral Monitoring Committee with the Ministry of Livestock and the Food Security Commission (CSA), uses MODIS and Copernicus satellite vegetation data alongside weekly sentinel-site reports.
title: Bulletin de surveillance pastorale de la Mauritanie, octobre-novembre 2025, N°36
publisher: Action Contre la Faim, with CSA, Ministère de l'Elevage and GNAP
why_not: Run by an NGO in partnership with government; issue date inferred from the publisher's listing, not in the PDF.
